summary: Callie came back this week with her most demanding messages since July: four distinct asks, up from 1 last window. They were mostly complaints. On Oct 11 Mayson announced her link-in-bio domain (crystalmila.vip) was 'back'. She replied 'I didn’t know it was down..', then objected to the 'crystal' branding on the management IG and the link ('crystal just also itself sounds fake') and asked for the OF link to say milabrooks. She also reported that the crystal account has lost about 100 followers since ALTR started posting on it and 'doesn’t seem to be growing at all'. Mayson committed to the rename ('Yes it’s me we’ll get it fixed', 'Yes 100%'). For the follower drop he only tagged the IG farm vendor ('@StardustNexus any reason why?'). Nobody had answered in writing by window end (4.5 days). She also restated the main IG account ('hopefully will get the bigger account sorted soon'), now 115 days open. Billing: Stephski sent a heads-up Oct 13 and the Oct 1-14 invoice Oct 15. That made eight invoices against two receipt confirmations, and the five-cycle reconciliation flagged since Sep 18 still did not go out first. This time Callie asked a payment question ('Is that a different account ?'). Stephski said the account was unchanged but told her to 'always double check' because of 'some swaps in the past'. Callie paid in 3h36m, and 'Thank you queen!' again did not confirm receipt. Mica held her cadence: an upload request Oct 12, which Callie completed Oct 14, and 8 reel-inspo links Oct 14, which Callie thanked. CHURN: the owner-silent signal fires today. Derrek last posted Sep 16, 30 days ago, and the Aug 1 rollout promise is 76 days overdue. Two of four exit signals are now firing.

Derrek's last message in this chat was Sep 16 02:53 (a banking answer), 30 days ago, and he did not respond to anything this week, including a branding complaint and a results complaint about an account his team runs. (2) Results question answered with a call offer: NOT firing in the strict sense, because no call was offered. But the results question got no answer at all. Callie's Oct 11 report that the crystal account dropped ~100 followers got only an internal-looking vendor tag ('@StardustNexus any reason why?') and no written explanation in 4.5 days. Close to firing. (3) Long-promised deliverable with no written proof: FIRING. The Aug 1 phone-farm rollout 'updates starting next week' are 76 days overdue. The main IG account is 115 days open and Callie restated it Oct 11. The only distribution she can see, the crystal account, is shrinking by her own count. (4) Most ALTR messages billing: NOT firing, but rising. 5 of 12 ALTR messages were billing (Stephski), up from 3 of 12. Client asks by window: Sep 18: 1 -> Sep 25: 0 -> Oct 2: 0 -> Oct 9: 1 -> Oct 16: 4 (OF link rename, who owns the insta account, why the crystal account is not growing, whether the bank account changed). She is not going quiet; she is asking again, which is better than silence. But three of the four asks are dissatisfaction ('sounds fake', 'dropped about 100 followers', 'Is that a different account ?'), not requests for more work. Why not lower: Mayson answered within a minute and committed to the rename. Stephski answered the bank question in 53 minutes. Mica's cadence held and Callie thanked her. Callie uploaded content on request. Why not higher: two exit signals firing, an unanswered results complaint, a missed reconciliation deadline (an eighth invoice went out on top of five unconfirmed cycles), and the 'double check' reply shifts verification onto the client. She also learned about the link outage only after it was fixed.
